vocab.sentence: I joined the club after school started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 開學後，我加入了這個社團。

vocab.sentence: This book is interesting, but that one is boring.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這本書很有趣，但那本很無聊。

vocab.sentence: We study science when we meet on Tuesdays.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們星期二聚在一起時會學習科學。

vocab.sentence: My favorite subject is English. What is yours?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我最喜歡的科目是英文。你呢？

vocab.sentence: I heard a noise when I opened the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開門時聽見了一個聲音。

vocab.sentence: Your bag is the same color as mine.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你的包包和我的是同一個顏色。

vocab.sentence: Call me after you finish your homework.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你寫完功課後打給我。

vocab.sentence: Tell me when you need help.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你需要幫忙時告訴我。

vocab.sentence: The poor boy smiled when he got the book.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個貧窮的男孩拿到書時笑了。

vocab.sentence: We went home after the game ended.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比賽結束後，我們回家了。

vocab.sentence: Whose camera is this?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這是誰的相機？

vocab.sentence: This camera is hers.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台相機是她的。

vocab.sentence: Your bag is blue, but mine is red.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你的包包是藍色的，但我的是紅色的。

vocab.sentence: I called the wrong number before I called you.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我打給你之前先打錯了電話。

vocab.sentence: We study math before we have lunch.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們午餐前上數學課。

vocab.sentence: We played soccer after school ended.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 放學後，我們踢了足球。

vocab.sentence: We speak Chinese when we are at home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在家時說中文。

vocab.sentence: I read a history book before I went to bed.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我睡前讀了一本歷史書。

vocab.sentence: This violin is mine.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這把小提琴是我的。

vocab.sentence: Our robot is small, but theirs is big.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們的機器人很小，但他們的很大。

vocab.sentence: My health got better after I started exercising.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開始運動後，健康變好了。

vocab.sentence: We drink water after we have PE.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們上完體育課後喝水。

vocab.sentence: Ms. Lin smiled when she saw us.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 林女士看到我們時笑了。

vocab.sentence: The engineer checked the robot before the show started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 表演開始前，工程師檢查了機器人。

vocab.sentence: We practiced after the lesson ended.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 課程結束後，我們練習了。

vocab.sentence: My homework is difficult, but hers is easy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的功課很難，但她的很簡單。

vocab.sentence: My dad taught me math when I was little.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我小時候，爸爸教我數學。

vocab.sentence: I wash my own cup after I use it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我用完自己的杯子後會把它洗乾淨。

vocab.sentence: I finished my homework before I watched TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看電視前先完成了功課。

vocab.sentence: We took pictures when we went to the festival.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們參加節慶活動時拍了照。

vocab.sentence: We sat down before the movie started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 電影開始前，我們坐了下來。

vocab.sentence: I talked to Mom before I made my choice.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我做選擇前先和媽媽談了談。

vocab.sentence: I listen to music when I am happy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開心時會聽音樂。

vocab.sentence: I came back after the lesson ended.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 課程結束後，我回來了。

vocab.sentence: The lessons are free when you join the club.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 加入社團後，這些課程是免費的。

vocab.sentence: We ate dinner before the show started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 表演開始前，我們吃了晚餐。

vocab.sentence: We designed a robot after we joined the club.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 加入社團後，我們設計了一個機器人。

vocab.sentence: The swimmer rested after he finished the race.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位泳者比完賽後休息了。

vocab.sentence: I saw a fish when I swam underwater.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在水下游泳時看見了一條魚。

vocab.sentence: The winner smiled when she heard her name.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那位獲勝者聽到自己的名字時笑了。

vocab.sentence: We practiced before the contest started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 競賽開始前，我們練習了。

vocab.sentence: The guests arrived after we finished cooking.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們煮好飯後，客人們到了。

phrases.sentence: I made up my mind before I called her.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我打給她之前就下定決心了。

phrases.sentence: I was pulling your leg when I said that.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我說那句話時是在跟你開玩笑。

phrases.sentence: Please hold on when I check the number.

phrases.sentence_chinese: 你看起來很難過。怎麼了？

phrases.sentence: I signed up after I talked to my teacher.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我和老師談過後就報名了。

phrases.sentence: I looked for my keys before I left home.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我出門前找了我的鑰匙。

phrases.sentence: I was not tired at all after the walk.
Sign up before Friday so you don't miss out.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 星期五以前報名，才不會錯過機會。

tips.label: after：在……之後
tips.text: A after B：先 B，再 A。例：I rested after I finished my work.（先完成工作，再休息。）

tips.label: before：在……之前
tips.text: A before B：先 A，再 B。例：I washed my hands before I ate.（先洗手，再吃飯。）

tips.label: when：當……的時候
tips.text: 用 when 引出某件事發生的時間或期間。例：I sing when I am happy.（我開心時唱歌。）

tips.label: 時間子句放句首
tips.text: 時間子句放句首時，後面加逗號：After class ended, we went home.

tips.label: 所有格代名詞
tips.text: mine／ours／yours／his／hers／theirs 代替「所有格＋名詞」，後面不再接名詞。

tips.label: whose：誰的
tips.text: Whose camera is this? = Whose is this? 可回答：It is mine.

tips.label: 雙重所有格
tips.text: a friend of mine＝我的一位朋友；a friend of my mom’s＝我媽媽的一位朋友。

notes.title: 從屬連接詞與子句
notes.description: 主要子句能表達完整意思；由 after、before、when 引導的時間子句補充時間資訊，在本課句型中須搭配主要子句。連接兩個子句時，時間子句內仍須有主詞和適當形式的動詞。
examples: She used the computer after she finished her dinner.（她吃完晚餐後使用電腦。）
He sings this song when he is happy.（他開心時會唱這首歌。）

notes.title: after 與 before 的先後順序
notes.rule: A after B：B 先、A 後；A before B：A 先、B 後
notes.description: 判斷順序時，看連接詞後面的完整事件。after 引出較早發生的事，before 引出較晚發生的事。句子中誰寫在前面，不一定就是誰先發生。
examples: He washed his hands after he used the bathroom.（先上廁所，再洗手。）
I drank some milk before I went to bed.（先喝牛奶，再睡覺。）

notes.title: when 的時間關係
notes.description: when 可表示某件事發生的時刻或期間；本課常用於同時發生的習慣、當時的狀態或某事件發生時的反應，不表示所有情境都必須精確同時。
examples: Mike usually eats popcorn when he watches TV.（Mike 通常看電視時吃爆米花。）
Ted helped me when I was in trouble.（我有困難時，Ted 幫助了我。）

notes.title: 時間子句的位置與標點
notes.rule: After／Before／When＋主詞＋動詞, 主要子句.
notes.description: 時間子句可放在主要子句前面或後面；放句首時，先寫完整時間子句，再加逗號。放句尾時通常不加逗號。移動位置不改變兩件事的時間關係。
examples: After she finished her dinner, she used the computer.（她吃完晚餐後使用電腦。）
Before the movie started, I turned off my phone.（電影開始前，我把手機關掉。）
When he is happy, he sings this song.（他開心時會唱這首歌。）

notes.title: 本課的時態搭配
notes.rule: 習慣：現在簡單式；已發生的事件：過去簡單式
notes.description: 本課例句通常以相同時間背景敘述兩件事：習慣用現在式，昨天或去年發生的事用過去式。現在式要注意第三人稱單數動詞。這是依情境選時態，不是所有時間子句永遠必須與主要子句使用相同時態。
examples: He takes a walk after he has dinner.（他吃完晚餐後會散步。）
She ate an egg before she went to school.（她上學前吃了一顆蛋。）
When we were in the club last year, we read many books.（去年在社團時，我們讀了很多書。）

notes.title: before 與 after 的同義改寫
notes.rule: A before B = B after A
notes.description: 交換兩個事件的位置，並將 before 改為 after，即可保持原來的先後關係。只換連接詞而不交換事件，會改變句意。
examples: Amy washes her hands before she eats. = Amy eats after she washes her hands.（Amy 先洗手，再吃飯。）
He closed the door after I came into the house. = I came into the house before he closed the door.（我先進屋，他再關門。）

notes.title: 所有格與所有格代名詞
notes.description: 所有格放在名詞前；所有格代名詞直接代替「所有格＋名詞」，避免重複。mine 和 his 的形式需特別記；yours、hers、ours、theirs 不加撇號。
examples: This is my book, not your book. = This is my book, not yours.（這是我的書，不是你的。）
This is her violin. The violin is hers.（這是她的小提琴。這把小提琴是她的。）
Our robot is small, but theirs is big.（我們的機器人很小，但他們的很大。）

notes.title: 名詞所有格可省略已知名詞
notes.rule: 單數名詞或人名＋'s；以 s 結尾的複數名詞＋'
notes.description: 表示某人的物品時，可省略已知名詞。the boy's 表示一位男孩的；the boys' 表示多位男孩的。一般人名如 Alan 加 's；以 s 結尾的人名可見 James's 或 James' 等寫法，本教材不以此差異出單一答案題。
examples: The boat is Diana's.（這艘船是 Diana 的。）
The ball is the boy's.（這顆球是那個男孩的。）
The big room is the girls'.（那個大房間是那些女孩的。）

notes.title: 所有格代名詞與動詞單複數
notes.rule: 動詞依所有格代名詞所代替的名詞決定單複數
notes.description: mine、hers、theirs 等本身沒有單複數變化。它們代替單數物品時搭配 is，代替複數物品時搭配 are；不能只看擁有者有幾個人。
examples: Your pens are blue, but mine are red.（mine＝my pens，所以用 are。）
Our robot is small, but theirs is big.（theirs＝their robot，所以用 is。）

notes.title: 雙重所有格
notes.rule: a／an／this／that／some／any…＋名詞＋of＋所有格代名詞或名詞所有格
notes.description: 表示某人的其中一個或一些事物時，可用雙重所有格。a friend of mine 中，of 後用 mine，不用 my、me 或 I；若擁有者是名詞，也要保留所有格形式。
examples: Jessie is a friend of mine.（Jessie 是我的一位朋友。）
Mr. Cooks is an old friend of my mom's.（Cooks 先生是我媽媽的一位老朋友。）
Ben is a friend of ours.（Ben 是我們的一位朋友。）

notes.title: whose 詢問所有權
notes.rule: Whose＋名詞＋be＋指示代名詞？／Whose＋be＋代名詞？
notes.description: whose 表示「誰的」，可放在名詞前，也可在物品已知時省略名詞。回答可用 mine、hers、Alan's 等。注意 whose 與 who's 不同；who's 是 who is 或 who has 的縮寫。
examples: Whose book is this? It is mine.（這是誰的書？是我的。）
A bag is under the sofa. Whose is it? It is hers.（沙發下有一個包包。是誰的？是她的。）
Whose books are these? They are Alan's.（這些是誰的書？是 Alan 的。）

quiz.question: The lesson ended at 4:00. Amy left at 4:10. She left _____ the lesson ended.
quiz.hint: 課程 4:00 結束，Amy 4:10 才離開；離開在後，after 後接先發生的事。

quiz.question: The show started at 7:00. We arrived at 6:30. We arrived _____ the show started.
quiz.hint: 我們 6:30 到，表演 7:00 才開始；抵達在先，用 before 引出較晚的事。

quiz.question: Ben finished his work at 5:00 and called me at 5:10. He called me _____ he finished his work.
quiz.hint: 先完成工作，再打電話；after 後接先完成的工作。

quiz.question: The contest began at 9:00. The engineer checked the robot at 8:30. He checked it _____ the contest began.
quiz.hint: 8:30 檢查在 9:00 開賽之前，因此用 before。

quiz.question: I joined the club on Monday and got my first lesson on Tuesday. I got my first lesson _____ I joined the club.
quiz.hint: 星期一先加入，星期二才上第一堂課；用 after 表示上課在加入之後。

quiz.question: Ms. Lin called at 3:00. I came back at 3:30. She called _____ I came back.
quiz.hint: 林女士先打電話，我後來才回來；before 後接較晚發生的回來。

quiz.question: （表達「每當」開心時）I sing this song _____ I am happy.
quiz.hint: 此處表達開心時就唱歌，兩者的時間重疊，用 when；before／after 會改變指定的時間關係。

quiz.question: （表達「當……的時候」）_____ I was little, my dad taught me math.
quiz.hint: 教數學的事發生在我小的那段期間，用 When 引出時間子句。

quiz.question: （表達同時發生的習慣）Mike eats popcorn _____ he watches TV.
quiz.hint: 題意是看電視時吃爆米花，用 when 連接同時發生的習慣。

quiz.question: （表達「先洗手，再吃飯」）Amy eats _____ she washes her hands.
quiz.hint: 洗手在先、吃飯在後，所以 after 後面放 she washes her hands。

quiz.question: （表達「先練習，再參賽」）We practice _____ we enter the contest.
quiz.hint: 題目指定先練習、再參賽，用 before 引出較晚的參賽；after 會顛倒順序，when 表示參賽時練習，during 不能直接接完整子句。

quiz.question: （將時間子句放句首）After the lesson ended_____ we went home.
quiz.hint: 時間子句放在主要子句前面時，用逗號連接；不能用句號、問號或驚嘆號把它獨立成句。

quiz.question: Ben walked the dog before he _____ to the office yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 與 walked 表示過去；before 子句中的 go 也用過去式 went。

quiz.question: Emma always listens to music when she _____ math.
quiz.hint: always 表示現在的習慣，主詞 she 是第三人稱單數，study 改成 studies。

quiz.question: After he _____ his work yesterday, he exercised.
quiz.hint: yesterday 與 exercised 表示過去，after 子句用 finished。

quiz.question: The swimmer always rests after she _____ a race.
quiz.hint: always rests 表示習慣；時間子句主詞是 she，現在式用 finishes。

quiz.question: We _____ the robot before the show started last night.
quiz.hint: last night 與 started 表示過去，主要子句用過去式 checked。

quiz.question: When my brother _____ happy, he plays the violin.
quiz.hint: 現在的習慣中，my brother 是單數，be 動詞用 is。

quiz.question: I heard a strange noise when I _____ the door yesterday.
quiz.hint: heard 和 yesterday 都指出過去時間，因此用 opened。

quiz.question: My sister always washes her own cup after she _____ it.
quiz.hint: always washes 表示習慣；主詞 she 搭配第三人稱單數 uses。

quiz.question: We played soccer after the PE lesson _____ yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，時間子句用 ended。

quiz.question: When the guests _____ last night, we opened the door.
quiz.hint: last night 與 opened 表示過去，arrive 應用 arrived。

quiz.question: Ms. Lin always _____ us a story before the lesson ends.
quiz.hint: always 和 ends 表示現在的習慣，Ms. Lin 是單數，主要子句用 tells。

quiz.question: After I _____ up for the club yesterday, I called my friend.
quiz.hint: yesterday 和 called 表示過去，因此 sign 用 signed。

quiz.question: When we _____ in the history club last year, we read many books.
quiz.hint: last year 表示過去；主詞 we 搭配過去式 were。

quiz.question: I bought this camera. It is _____.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 my camera，後面沒有名詞，要用所有格代名詞 mine。

quiz.question: Amy bought this violin. It is _____.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 Amy 的小提琴，即 her violin，應用 hers。

quiz.question: We designed this robot together. It is _____.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 our robot，用所有格代名詞 ours。

quiz.question: The boys own this soccer ball. It is _____.
quiz.hint: the boys 對應 they；代替 their soccer ball 時用 theirs。

quiz.question: You bought this history book. It is _____.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 your history book，應用 yours。

quiz.question: Ben owns this camera. It is _____.
quiz.hint: Ben 對應 he，其所有格代名詞是 his，可單獨代替 his camera。

quiz.question: This is _____ robot. We designed it together.
quiz.hint: 空格後還有名詞 robot，所以用所有格 our；ours 後面不再接名詞。

quiz.question: Amy is looking for _____ violin. She owns a red one.
quiz.hint: 空格後有名詞 violin，要用所有格 her。

quiz.question: I have a blue camera. _____ camera is on the desk.
quiz.hint: camera 前面要用所有格 My；Mine 已包含名詞的意思，不能再接 camera。

quiz.question: You own this book. Is _____ book in your bag?
quiz.hint: 空格直接修飾 book，所以用所有格 your。

quiz.question: A: _____ camera is this? B: It is Ms. Lin's.
quiz.hint: 回答說明相機的主人，問「誰的」用 Whose；Who's 是 who is／who has 的縮寫。

quiz.question: A: There is a violin on the chair. _____ is it? B: It is mine.
quiz.hint: 已知物品是小提琴，可省略 whose 後的名詞，用 Whose is it? 問所有權。

quiz.question: Your pens are blue, but mine _____ red.
quiz.hint: mine 代替 my pens，是複數，所以 be 動詞用 are。

quiz.question: Our robot is small, but theirs _____ big.
quiz.hint: theirs 代替 their robot，robot 是單數，搭配 is。

quiz.question: My science books are new, but hers _____ old.
quiz.hint: hers 代替 her science books，指複數書本，因此用 are。

quiz.question: These two cameras belong to me. Both are _____.
quiz.hint: mine 可代替複數的 my cameras，不因數量增加而改形。

quiz.question: I have many friends. Jessie is a friend of _____.
quiz.hint: a friend of mine 是雙重所有格，表示我的朋友之一；of 後面用所有格代名詞。

quiz.question: We have several friends in the club. Ben is a friend of _____.
quiz.hint: a friend of ours 表示我們的朋友之一；雙重所有格使用 ours。

quiz.question: Amy knows many engineers. Mr. Wu is an old friend of _____.
quiz.hint: an old friend of hers 是雙重所有格，表示她的一位老朋友。

quiz.question: Tom and Tim share one room. This is the two _____ room.
quiz.hint: two boys 是以 s 結尾的複數名詞，表示所有格時在 s 後加撇號，成為 boys'。

quiz.question: Only one girl owns this violin. It is the _____.
quiz.hint: 只有一位女孩，單數 girl 加 's，並省略已知的 violin。

quiz.question: Alan owns this robot. The robot is _____.
quiz.hint: 人名 Alan 的所有格是 Alan's，可單獨代替 Alan's robot。

quiz.question: （表達「那台相機是我媽媽的」）That camera on the desk is my _____.
quiz.hint: my mom 是單數的擁有者，加 's 成為 my mom's，並省略已知的 camera；不能用沒有所有格標記的 mom。

quiz.question: （請對方指認自己的相機）A: Which camera is _____? B: The red one is mine.
quiz.hint: 問對方哪一台是「你的相機」，空格代替 your camera，要用 yours。

quiz.question: These are our science books. Those are their science books. Those books are _____.
quiz.hint: 空格代替 their science books，沒有後接名詞，使用 theirs。

vocab.sentence: I joined the club after school started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 開學後，我加入了這個社團。

vocab.sentence: This book is interesting, but that one is boring.
